label: Support and paraphrase
source: The trial found that 68% of participants reported improved sleep after eight weeks of using the device.
claim: The device was associated with better sleep in many participants.

label: Direct contradiction
source: The company discontinued the product in 2021.
claim: The product was still sold in 2023.

label: Causation confusion
source: Sales rose after the advertising campaign, but the report did not establish whether the campaign caused the rise.
claim: The advertising campaign caused the sales increase.

label: Negation
source: The mayor did not attend the emergency briefing.
claim: The mayor attended the emergency briefing.

label: Numerical mismatch
source: Only 33% of patients reported improvement after the treatment.
claim: More than half of the patients reported improvement after the treatment.

label: Population mismatch
source: In a study of 150 children with asthma, the treatment reduced symptom severity.
claim: The treatment reduced symptom severity in adults with asthma.

label: Time period mismatch
source: The 2024 audit found emissions fell by 8% compared with 2023.

label: Some versus all
source: Some residents supported the zoning change, while others opposed it.
claim: All residents supported the zoning change.

label: Explicit support
source: The policy reduced average wait times from 14 minutes to 9 minutes.
claim: Average wait times decreased after the policy.

label: No significant difference
source: Researchers found no significant difference in outcomes between the treatment and control groups.
claim: The treatment improved outcomes for all patients.

label: Neutral evidence
source: The device was tested in a laboratory under controlled conditions.
claim: The device is safe for home use.

label: Minority support
source: Only 12 out of 40 participants reported side effects.
claim: A minority of participants reported side effects.
